evidence.quote:
## Corrections that materially improved the renderer

- The former `qofchedy` instruction “take … dry … finish” is removed. Both
  `ofchedy` and `qofchedy` now remain nominal complete-word result candidates,
  with five exact occurrences each.
- The old `lchor = woody plant part` composition remains retired. Its current
  bold default is the less specific **flower preparation**, with flower extract
  retained as a rival.

## Why the dry/moist same-part model lost

The raw D1 state counts initially look promising:

| target | ED0 DRY/MOIST | ED1 | ED2 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `chor` | 45/9 | 28/9 | 12/7 |
| `shor` | 8/12 | 8/5 | 7/2 |

`chor` remains dry-affine, though weakly. `shor`, however, is moist-affine
only at ED0; it reverses to dry-affine after near-family forms are removed.
The direct state opposition therefore survives just one of three radii.

Two inherited line defaults were corrected before carrying the twelve-line reader forward:

- `sain` is no longer rendered from the old EVA-`s` plant association. Its recurring complete-word behavior is a fused amount/value form II. The concrete reader default is `zwei Drachmen`, while drachms versus equal parts or ounces remains C0 at unit level.
- `chekar` is source-composed in the GDT754 registry, so its former hot/dry/fraction semantics cannot enter as whole-word evidence. In `f75r.43` it is now only the forced local C0 placeholder `Zwischenzubereitung`; even a concrete intermediate operation is not independently established.

## Vergleich zum alten `Grundansatz`

Alle 376 Stellen kreuzen zum alten GDT683-Output `Grundansatz`; alle beruhen
auf derselben geerbten GDT664-Karte, nicht auf 376 unabhängigen Bestätigungen.
GDT774 verwirft diesen Bestand nicht. Es zerlegt ihn in 49
gerichtete Feldausgaben und 327 schwächere nominale
Fallbacks. Öl, Wasser und Wein bleiben ununterscheidbar.

decisions.reason: Exact existing card has the GDT766 retired-composition source case. No omission.
Source gives only “take … dry … finish”, an elliptical summary. Do not manufacture a complete historical lexical sentence from omitted words; no exact recovery proposed.
Dry/moist same-part model already represented. Family-ablation nonconfirmation does not justify duplicating it as newly recovered old lexemes.

sain old EVA-s plant association and chekar old hot/dry/fraction semantics are summarized rather than a complete old lexical sentence. No precise absent sentence can be recovered from these four-report spans alone.

ol=Grundansatz already has GDT664/665/683 source cases; GDT774 explicitly does not discard this inventory, but splits contextual outputs and nominal fallbacks. It is not an unrecorded wholesale withdrawal.

checks: Current and archive exact/related claims scanned without dumping registry; lchor and ol full relevant source cases inspected through bounded priorities. All evidence spans generated from original report lines and hashed. No source-owner recovery required because no card is nominated.
